## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] New or changed checks have a public spec URL, a fix (summary, agent prompt, snippet where it helps), a knowledge-base article and a fixture that passes and one that fails
- [ ] `docs/checks.md` regenerated when the catalog changed (`pnpm docs:generate`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased
- [ ] No secrets, no private hostnames, nothing that references unreleased partner work
